body:
The first release of TF2Tools 6: TF2Tools rebuilt from the ground up as a native desktop app. It replaces TF2Tools 4, which ran inside a web browser engine, and is lighter and quicker to use. Everything below is new since TF2Tools 4.8.0.

## What's Changed

- **A new app:** TF2Tools now runs as a regular desktop app on Windows and Linux, with no browser engine inside.
- **HUDs:** keep all your HUDs in one library and switch with one click. TF2Tools offers to install any fonts a HUD needs.
- **HUD Store:** the hand-picked list from hud-db, or everything on GameBanana.
- **Hitsounds and killsounds:** add your own or download them from the Sound Store, and play them in the app before you pick.
- **A crosshair for every weapon:** go class by class and give each weapon one of TF2's crosshairs, an image of your own or one from the Crosshair Store.
- **mastercomfig addons:** install them from the Addon Store and get updates when mastercomfig releases new ones.
- **Crosshair Maker:** draw your own crosshair pixel by pixel, with a preview over a map.
- **HUD Maker:** see your HUD the way the game draws it, then move, resize, recolour or hide any part of it.
- **Profiles:** save your HUD, sounds and crosshairs together and switch your whole setup at once.
- **Updates:** TF2Tools checks for new versions and installs them itself on Windows and with the AppImage.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/compare/v4.8.0...v6.0.1

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | `TF2Tools.exe` |
| Linux x86_64 | `tf2tools_6.0.1_x86_64.AppImage` (most Linux systems) or `tf2tools_6.0.1_amd64.deb` (Ubuntu and Debian) |

Each file also has a copy with no version in its name, for links that always point at the latest release. Check a download with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`.

## Before you install

- **Windows:** Windows may show a blue box saying "Windows protected your PC". TF2Tools is free and not signed with a paid certificate, so Windows does not recognise it yet. Click "More info", then "Run anyway". Only do this for the file from this page. TF2Tools 6 installs next to TF2Tools 4; once it works, you can remove the old one in Windows Settings > Apps.
- **Linux AppImage:** after downloading, right-click the file, open Properties, allow it to run as a program, then double-click it.
- **Linux .deb:** open it with your software installer.

## Updates

On Windows and with the AppImage, TF2Tools checks for new versions and installs them itself, after checking their signature. The .deb does not update itself; get new versions from the Releases page.
